title: polystichum fragrans
intro: Polystichum fragrans, commonly known as the Fragrant Maidenhair Fern, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health due to its high content of antioxidants and volatile compounds. The therapeutic actions of Polystichum fragrans include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of colds, coughs, and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
